items.label: Camphor
items.flagged_reason: T-08 is an open outline (12 gaps, up to 40 cm). Muse Spark says one tree; please confirm.

spark.why: Twelve straight pieces form one ring of radius 2.0 m with gaps under 0.4 m; the centre cross matches the seven closed canopies; "CAMPHOR, typ." on T-03 applies to identical symbols.

answer.why: Twelve short segments form a single circular canopy with centre mark matching the adjacent tree symbol of same size.

checks.title: T-08 is an open outline; Muse Spark says one tree
checks.why: Geometry closes seven canopies; the eighth has 12 gaps up to 40 cm. Muse Spark sees one tree and why; a person confirms.

checks.title: Schedule and bill say 12 Camphor, the drawing shows 8
checks.why: L-4 and the bill list 12 Camphor; L-1 shows 8 canopies and its own schedule says 8. The drawing governs; raise it with the developer.

checks.title: Two revisions of L-1: Rev B is newer and shows 9 trees
checks.why: Rev A (2026-09-18) and Rev B (2026-10-14) are both in the folder. Counts are shown for both; confirm which revision the quote follows.

checks.title: L-2 is an elevation — the same trees, not counted
checks.why: Muse Spark classed L-2 as an elevation: the eight trees drawn from the side. Counting them would double the trees.

checks.title: L-5 is an enlarged plan — four trees repeated, not counted
checks.why: A match line at x = 21 m ties L-5 to L-1; T-01 to T-04 appear on both.

checks.title: L-7 and L-8 show canopies as background
checks.why: Irrigation and lighting sheets draw the trees dashed for reference; they are not planting sheets.

checks.title: Legend symbol is not a tree
checks.why: The tree symbol inside the legend box is excluded from the count.

checks.title: A tree is drawn outside the site, in the road reserve
checks.why: T-09 sits 3.6 m south of the boundary. It is drawn, not counted toward greening, and not ours to plant.

checks.title: A tree is drawn inside the fire-truck access lane
checks.why: T-10 is inside the hatched lane, an area where greening cannot count; it may also block the lane.

citation.article: Building Technical Regulations §299 — definitions: area hard to green
citation.gloss: Fire-truck access lanes and similar areas are excluded from the minimum greening area.

checks.title: Paving on L-3 overlaps the lawn on L-1 by 20 m²
checks.why: The permeable-paver hatch on L-3 runs 20 m² into the lawn drawn on L-1: that area would be priced twice.

checks.title: Tree pits on the slab are too shallow for large trees
checks.why: L-6: pit 1.2 × 1.2 m (1.44 m²), soil 0.8 m on the basement slab. Large trees then count as small: Gi 1.5 → 1.0.

citation.article: Greening Design Technical Specification, Table 1 — carbon fixation by planting type
citation.gloss: On artificial ground, soil depth and pit size set which Gi class a tree may claim.

checks.title: Azalea: 450 plants for 150 m² is 3 per m²; the schedule asks 4
checks.why: At 4 plants per m² the bed needs 600. The bill is 150 plants short.

checks.title: Greening carbon fixation is short: 268.1 of 297.0 kgCO₂e/yr
checks.why: One tree species gives no native-tree bonus (α 0.8). Σ Gi × Ai = 335.1, × 0.8 = 268.1, below the 297.0 required for a 1,500 m² ordinary site at 40% coverage.

citation.article: Building Technical Regulations §302 — greening carbon-fixation requirement
citation.gloss: The planting’s total carbon fixation must exceed ½ × the minimum greening area × β (β 0.66 on an ordinary site).

fixes.label: swap 2 of 8 Camphor for Bischofia (Bischofia javanica), a second native species — α 0.8 → 1.3, no extra trees

checks.title: Existing camphor DBH 95 cm marked "to be removed"
checks.why: A trunk of this size may be a protected tree under the local tree protection rule. Removal needs a review before the permit.

citation.article: Local tree protection rule — trees of protected size
citation.gloss: Trees above a set trunk size may not be removed without approval.

checks.title: L-5: the title block says 1:200, the scale bar measures 1:100
checks.why: Areas measured on this sheet at the title-block scale would be four times too large.

checks.title: Hedge: bill 150 plants, drawing 182
checks.why: 27.0 m at 0.3 m in two rows is 182 plants. The bill prices 150 — 32 short.

checks.title: "Camphore tree" aligned to Camphor at lower confidence
checks.why: BOQ rev1a spells it "Camphore tree"; Muse Spark aligned it to CC Camphor at 0.81.

checks.title: Camphor at NT$5,000 is 65% under your price list
checks.why: Your list prices Camphor cal. 10 cm at NT$14,000–16,000. At NT$5,000 the row cannot buy the specified tree.

checks.title: Permeable pavers at NT$3,800/m² are twice your list
checks.why: Your list: NT$1,700–2,000 per m².

checks.title: The subtotal skips row 11
checks.why: =SUM(F5:F10) leaves out the grass pavers: the subtotal is NT$54,000 short.

checks.title: A hidden sheet holds other totals
